fields.name: holding_id
fields.description: Stable identifier of the holder line.

fields.name: listing_id
fields.description: Listing.

fields.name: firm_id
fields.description: Firm the line is attributed to (all vehicles a firm controls are combined).

fields.name: holder_as_filed
fields.description: Holder as named in the source filing.

fields.name: holder_type
fields.description: Holder category of this line.

fields.name: stake_pct
fields.description: Shares held going into the listing, as-converted, as a percentage of post-offering shares (after closing for SPAC mergers); blank where the holding is known but not sized (stake_confidence KNOWN_UNSIZED). Unit: %.

fields.name: stake_pct_low
fields.description: Low estimate of stake_pct where the stake is estimated. Unit: %.

fields.name: stake_pct_high
fields.description: High estimate of stake_pct where the stake is estimated. Unit: %.

fields.name: stake_confidence
fields.description: Confidence in stake_pct (KNOWN_UNSIZED: holding known but not sized).

fields.name: stake_source
fields.description: Filing or method behind stake_pct (for example a 424B4 footnote, Form 3, 13F count, round arithmetic).

fields.name: primary_evidence
fields.description: Evidence grade for whether the shares were bought from the company.

fields.name: secondary_fraction
fields.description: Quantified share of the stake bought from other holders, where one is known.

fields.name: primary_share
fields.description: Share of the stake counted as bought from the company (primary).

fields.name: primary_share_low
fields.description: Low case of primary_share where it is uncertain.

fields.name: primary_share_high
fields.description: High case of primary_share where it is uncertain.

fields.name: first_round
fields.description: Round of the firm's first investment in the company.

fields.name: entry_year
fields.description: Year of the firm's first investment.

fields.name: led_round
fields.description: Whether the firm led a round.

fields.name: led_round_detail
fields.description: Detail behind led_round where recorded.

fields.name: board_seat_at_listing
fields.description: Whether the firm held a board seat at listing.

fields.name: board_seat_detail
fields.description: Detail behind board_seat_at_listing where recorded.

fields.name: secondary_noted
fields.description: Whether a sale or purchase of existing shares was noted.

fields.name: value_at_listing_usd_bn
fields.description: stake_pct / 100 x listings.value_at_listing_usd_bn. Unit: USD bn.

fields.name: value_end_usd_bn
fields.description: stake_pct / 100 x listings.value_end_usd_bn (2 October 2026 close). Unit: USD bn.

fields.name: primary_value_usd_bn
fields.description: value_end_usd_bn x primary_share. Unit: USD bn.

fields.name: inside_capital_at_risk_share
fields.description: Share of the line held by vehicles inside the firm's capital at risk (below 1 where part is held by vehicles outside it, such as Sequoia's Global Equities fund).

fields.name: primary_value_counted_usd_bn
fields.description: primary_value_usd_bn x inside_capital_at_risk_share: the value counted in firm_metrics. Unit: USD bn.

fields.name: provenance_confidence
fields.description: Confidence in the primary-share assessment (blank for lines added in the version 7 coverage check, graded in stake_confidence).

fields.name: provenance_source_url
fields.description: Source URLs, separated by ";".

fields.name: provenance_note
fields.description: Evidence, method and arithmetic behind the stake and primary share.

fields.name: change_note_v17
fields.description: Correction made in book v17 (report version 8), with its filing.
